items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: So I happened to say to him, I said, well, Harry, how'd you make out tonight?

ctx.x: St. Bernard in Claiborne. St. Bernard.

Yeah. And then Harry Wills got on, you know. So I happened to say he was fighting rough house swears that night, see. So I happened to say to him, I said, well, Harry, how'd you make out tonight? He said, well... I tell you, he says, I'll win. He said, but that nigga sure is rough. He sure is rough. A rough house swears was his name.
He died with owning a lot of New York property up south. He did well.
